sentences.text: `` Southern Hospitality '' is the second single released off Ludacris 's album Back for the First Time , released in 2000 .	Ludacris	Ludacris	Back for the First Time	Back for the First Time
It was composed by The Neptunes .	The Neptunes	The Neptunes
The song debuted at # 86 on the Billboard Hot 100 on January 20 , 2001 , reached the Top 40 at # 38 on February 10 , 2001 , and peaked at # 23 on March 24 .
